market_question: Will Houston Texans win the 2027 NFL AFC Championship?
reasoning: The Houston Texans have never reached an AFC Championship game and play in a conference dominated by established powers like the Chiefs, Bills, and Ravens. While C.J. Stroud and DeMeco Ryans provide a solid foundation, converting that into a conference title by 2027 requires multiple deep playoff wins against elite teams—a roughly 3–4% proposition in my assessment, well below the 8.7% implied by the market.
evidence_points: Texans have zero AFC Championship appearances in franchise history, with their deepest run being a divisional round loss in 2023.
The AFC features multiple perennial Super Bowl contenders (Chiefs, Bills, Ravens, Bengals) that have deep playoff experience and elite rosters.

While the Texans are a rising team, statistical models and historical conversion rates from 'promising young core' to 'conference champion' support a single-digit probability for a specific future year.
